note: All regions, anchors, timings and export names are proposed. Regions guide asset responsibilities; they are not extraction rectangles or existing separated assets.

layers.title: 01 · Distant city
layers.description: Complete skyline, bridges, occupied windows and fixed banks behind the station.
layers.motion: Still architecture; keep the train track empty in this plate.
layers.notes: Draw complete scenery behind moving and removable objects. Use current Confluence materials and the approved composition.

layers.title: 02 · Distant train
layers.description: One small train travels along the upper central bridge.
layers.motion: A rigid train moves behind bridge parapets and station columns; restrained window changes.
layers.timing: 12–18 s crossing; 25–45 s gap after exit
layers.notes: Use a menu-owned event track. Freeze travel and the gap during gameplay or hidden tabs.

layers.title: 03 · Canal mist
layers.description: A few localized atmosphere patches above the canal and in the middle distance.
layers.motion: Slow masked drift; no haze crossing menu labels or Cole's face.
layers.notes: Preserve deliberate pixel texture. Keep this optional layer quiet and bounded.

layers.title: 04 · Station structure
layers.description: Blue-glass shelter, steel columns, left wall/arch, pipes and fixed housings.
layers.motion: Structural masses and their supports stay fixed.
layers.notes: The region highlights the canopy; this group also includes the left framing wall. Finish hidden surfaces and preserve physical mounts.

layers.title: 05 · Canal surface
layers.description: The cyan water surface, bounded by the canal banks and the diagonal foreground lip.
layers.motion: Slow advancing pixel currents and broken horizontal highlights.
layers.timing: 8-frame material loop, about 1.2–1.6 s, plus slow masked travel
layers.notes: The rectangle is a guide; the real boundary requires a shoreline-shaped mask. Keep static bright shimmer out of the clean plate.

layers.title: 06 · Falling water
layers.description: A narrow water ribbon starts behind the fixed mouth rim and meets the canal.
layers.motion: Downward authored flow; the pipe itself stays still.
layers.notes: Mouth near (543,568); impact near (573,698). Align both in scene coordinates.

layers.title: 07 · Outfall splash
layers.description: A small impact patch where the stream meets the surface.
layers.motion: Irregular short splashes and ripples, with timing offset from the water ribbon.
layers.notes: Keep the impact seated at the waterline; its spray must not slide with the current.

layers.title: 08 · Quay and paving
layers.description: Wet masonry, supported bench feet and the diagonal bank edge.
layers.motion: Fixed physical material; changing reflections are separate.
layers.notes: Finish paving under Cole and the cat. The bank lip covers the canal edge. Keep the water/ground masks distinct.

layers.title: 09 · Wet-ground reflections
layers.description: Localized magenta, cyan and amber responses on wet paving.
layers.motion: Broken masked highlights; Cole's magenta brightness follows his current flame phase.
layers.timing: Phase-linked to Cole and surface motion
layers.notes: Draw for the ground perspective; do not paste a flat mirrored whole character onto the angled paving.

layers.title: 10 · Bench and rear rails
layers.description: Bench back, seat, rear railings and terminal housing behind the actors.
layers.motion: Fixed furniture, including complete surfaces hidden by the seated bodies.
layers.notes: Separate front arms and rails only where they pass in front of Cole or the cat.

layers.title: 11 · Cole, complete frames
layers.description: The entire seated canon character, including connected fire and the cloak under his weight.
layers.motion: Two flame cycles across one slower loose-scarf cycle; resting anatomy and support pixels held.
layers.timing: 16 × 100 ms = 1.6 s; proposed cell up to 512 × 512
layers.notes: Inspect a few keyframes first. No detached flame/head layers, enlarged gameplay cell, floating boots or streaming cloth beneath the seated hips.

layers.title: 12 · Sleeping cat
layers.description: The complete skeletal cat resting beside Cole.
layers.motion: Small authored upper-body breathing; paws and lower contact stay registered. Sleep marks are separate.
layers.timing: 8 × 350 ms = 2.8 s; z marks over 4–5 s
layers.notes: Keep the cat asleep in the first loop. Ear flicks or other variations can follow later.

layers.title: 13 · Foreground furniture
layers.description: Only the bench arms, supports and small rail edges that pass in front of the actors.
layers.notes: Use cut openings and carefully ordered drawing so a broad furniture crop does not cover faces, hands or legs.

layers.title: 14 · Terminal screen
layers.description: Small cyan screen content inside the terminal's fixed housing.
layers.motion: A restrained indicator or scan detail; its frame and mount stay fixed.
layers.timing: Small updates, less frequent than the water
layers.notes: Clip screen content to its inner face. No large scrolling text or distracting pulses.

layers.title: 15 · Local light
layers.description: Warm lamp cores and tight local lighting; housings belong to the structure.
layers.motion: Tiny changes in light intensity, with appropriate surface masks.
layers.notes: Distribute light passes at their receiving surfaces. Contact shadows remain under the actors. Do not pulse the whole image.

layers.title: 16 · Departure display
layers.description: The electronic departure board's clear face and deliberately rendered lettering.
layers.motion: A short refresh redraws the same message: ETERNALLY DELAYED.
layers.notes: Render lettering from controlled pixel glyphs or a pre-rendered text texture. Generated concept lettering is not a runtime text asset.

layers.title: 17 · Loose foliage tips
layers.description: A few foreground magenta tips; other rooted vegetation stays in the static plates.
layers.motion: Small authored shifts around fixed stems; optional sparse patches elsewhere.
layers.notes: The highlighted patch is one example. Keep roots fixed and avoid deforming the complete foreground.

layers.title: 18 · Real menu interface
layers.description: The real logo, menu actions, focus treatment and dialogs above the decorative scene.
layers.motion: Native focus/selection behavior; no baked fake controls.
layers.notes: Remove the concept's title/menu lettering from environment plates and the fallback poster. Continue eligibility, keyboard navigation, options and saved-game behavior stay owned by the app.
